personalInfo.title: Desarrollador Full Stack
personalInfo.profile: Proactive Desarrollador Full Stack with 3+ years of experience specializing in high-impact frontend architecture and robust backend integration using Vue, Laravel, PHP, and MySQL. Proven track record in responsive UX/UI programming and modern environment deployments with Docker. Actively integrated AI solutions utilizing Gemini API and Prompt Engineering for smart automation. Collaborative, result-oriented engineer delivering clean, maintainable code within Agile environments.

responsibilities: Architected and deployed over 50 highly responsive web platforms utilizing Bootstrap and SASS, ensuring exceptional UX/UI programming across all viewport resolutions.
Spearheaded content migration pipelines using Git version control, guaranteeing data integrity and zero downtime for active client ecosystems during platform transitions.
Engineered internal Python scripts and automation tools that streamlined style rendering workflows, reducing project delivery cycles and accelerating code deployment tasks.
Designed and executed core backend services using Laravel and PHP, optimizing MySQL databases to handle high-throughput transactions and improve application query latency.
Integrated generative AI features leveraging the Gemini API and Prompt Engineering, implementing automated workflows and smart configurations to enhance user interactivity.
Containerized applications using Docker to streamline deployments, collaborating on a microservices-based Nuxt frontend architecture to ensure rapid, seamless system integrations.
Developed and maintained responsive web interfaces using Vue 2, integrating them seamlessly with backend APIs to establish highly efficient cross-platform communication.
Deployed stable production releases and configured application environments via Git-driven pipelines, accelerating overall project delivery schedules by collaborating in agile squads.
Optimized data persistence layer with MongoDB and Express.js, designing robust RESTful services to sustain high concurrent traffic and elevate web application reliability.
